name: Non-Local Objective Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker with a global algebraic sum minimization ($E = \sum s_i \cdot 3^{n-i}$) and replaced the linear equation system with a cubic sum ($s_u^3 + s_v^3 = 9$). Both are mathematically isomorphic to the original conditions but remove the keywords that trigger standard graph-coloring heuristics. Models must now symbolically deduce that minimizing this sum is identical to the lexicographical prefix property, otherwise they will attempt intractable global optimization or naive BigInt simulation that will TLE.
